{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) and refunded orders
# First, check the count of QA orders
total_rows = len(data)
qa_rows = (data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
refunded_rows = (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum()

print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"QA rows (revenue == 999999.99): {qa_rows}")
print(f"Refunded rows: {refunded_rows}")

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
data_filtered = data[(data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the number of rows after filtering
print(f"Number of completed, non-QA orders: {len(data_filtered)}")

# Confirm the cleaned revenue column is numeric and valid
print("Sample of cleaned revenue (after filtering):")
print(data_filtered['revenue_clean'].head())"}
